'''Mercenaries''' are people who join a country's army, but are not from that country.

==Mercenaries in Caemlyn==
When [[Elayne Trakand]] was campaigning to [[Succession Wars#Fourth Succession War|win]] the [[Lion Throne]] of [[Andor]], she was reluctantly forced to hire outlanders to help he secure [[Caemlyn]].
